source: Actual browser, real API, same attempt opened in two authenticated tabs, no mocked requests
expected: Stale answer gets409 and cannot replace newer answer; explicit read saved answer restores authoritative value; reload/relogin keep it; keyboardEnter does not finalize

actionMeasurements.scenario: Restore authoritative answers after a real concurrent-tab conflict
actionMeasurements.startState: A real409 response displayed an explanation and Open saved answers; submit is disabled
actionMeasurements.endState: The saved first answer is checked and the stale second answer is not checked
actionMeasurements.instrumentation: Elapsed includes disabled-submit, geometry and screenshot assertions before recovery; conflict setup is counted in the separate full test measurement

actionMeasurements.scenario: Concurrent-tab, keyboard, clock, reload and relogin verification
actionMeasurements.startState: Authenticated learner course already open with prerequisites complete
actionMeasurements.endState: After deliberate reload and relogin the server-saved answer is still selected
actualSteps: Open same course in second tab
Space selects first answer; Enter, Tab and Escape do not submit
Select conflicting answer in second tab
Log out; re-enter email/password; log in
Open course and confirm saved answer
actionMeasurements.instrumentation: Programmatic focus, ±24h Date.now changes, viewport changes, API reads and screenshots are test instrumentation. Clock waits and assertions remain in elapsed time; two-tab setup is counted as one navigation. No final submission occurs.
